fusions.name: Rampart Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves with the full guard up, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Leaden Rebuke
fusions.desc: Butts the target for 4 damage and leaves it 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It has a 30% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Refusal
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Last Bastion
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 30% of your maximum health covers you for 8 seconds. Once every 90 seconds.
